brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

requirements.evidence: Three base cells in a row at level 0: piece:0,0,0;full (centre) flanked by piece:-1,0,0;half-n and piece:1,0,0;half-n, all one joined body (check_build shows a single group [-1,0 / 0,0 / 1,0]), each topped with a cover (cover:-1,0,0;half-n;top, cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;half-n;top). Open faces capped (9 caps) and joints locked (jointBolt placed).
drawer:0#-1,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut (classic style), one seated on the cut face of each half base at the two end cells.
setDrawerOpen applied to the drawer at {q:1,r:0,level:0} (drawer:0#1,0#cut); the drawer at {-1,0,0} remains closed by contrast.

finish.summary: A three-cell cabinet in a row: a full hex base in the centre flanked by two north-half bases, each half base carrying a classic drawer on its south cut face. The right-hand drawer (at 1,0,0) is set pulled open, the left stays closed. All three cells are topped with covers, open faces are capped, and joints are locked. check_build passes with no issues and meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Building your three-cell cabinet with two drawers — one pulled open. I'll check the current build and where drawers fit.

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
